name: Sierra Mexico🔥
desc:
Sierra Mexico! 🔥
Choose a faction, capture territories, and dominate the city alongside your team in an action-packed open world.

🚗 Drive realistic vehicles, armored vehicles, and turreted units. 
🚁 Pilots helicopters and airplanes. 
🔫 Use rifles, sniper rifles, machine guns, rocket launchers, and more. 
🦺 Equip uniforms and accessories from your faction. 
⚔️ Participate in combat, defend zones and conquer strategic points. 
🌎 Explore a map inspired by Mexico, optimized for different devices. 

💻 Compatible with computer, console, mobile and tablet. 
🛡️ Active moderation.
